description: During inspection, multiple violations were observed at the property located at 101030001. The front yard contained scattered debris, including broken furniture, discarded household items, and overgrown vegetation obstructing the sidewalk. The backyard fence was damaged, creating a potential safety hazard for neighboring properties. The garage door was left open with visible storage of combustible materials, raising fire safety concerns. The property owner was contacted and advised of the compliance requirements. A Notice of Pendency was generated, specifying a compliance period of 15 days. Reinspection has been scheduled to confirm corrective action. Failure to comply may result in further enforcement measures, including administrative fines or hearings before the Code Enforcement Board.
